subject.title: fix(browser): time out Google Docs page exports

question: Should the browser extension treat any Google Docs text export still pending after 30 seconds as failed, including unusually slow but otherwise successful authenticated documents?
rationale: The tests and live proof establish the timeout behavior, but they cannot determine the acceptable user-facing deadline for large or slow Google Docs exports.

options.title: Accept the 30-second bound
options.body: Merge the patch as written, prioritizing recovery of stuck sharing controls over waiting for unusually slow exports.

options.title: Choose a different policy
options.body: Request a different documented deadline or a separately designed retry/UX policy before landing the behavioral change.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second bound
recommendation.body: Merge the patch as written, prioritizing recovery of stuck sharing controls over waiting for unusually slow exports.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a bundled browser-extension availability-policy decision rather than a contributor-proof or mechanical repair question.
